name: Dinner Date
description: Three single cooks must make a meal for a blind date, but only one of them will impress enough to get a second date. Which chef will make someone hungry for more?

videos.title: Love at First Bite
videos.overview: Featuring memorable moments from the past seven series as well as interviews with celebrities and dating experts.
